newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Casa Autrey upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Casa Autrey upgraded.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Monday it had upgraded its rating for Mexico's Grupo Casa Autrey SA de CV to hold from reduce.
-- "The share price's 11 percent underperformance in the last two weeks reflects Autrey's loss of share in a contracting pharmaceutical market" in the third quarter, the firm said in an analysis.
"Following this correction, and clearer indications of the expected rate of progress of the abarottes (convenience store) business, we are upgrading our recommendation from reduce to hold."
-- The company's stock was unchanged at 19-1/8 in mid-afternoon trade in New York.
